note: First-pass numbers chosen by the assistant on 2026-11-14. None has been tuned with players. Version 3: the second decision is a call to Trauma Team (ids still say 'refer'); a call on a steady patient now costs the call-out (false_call). Agent limits were raised for typed and spoken conversation: 16 patient-model calls per visit, a 4 s wait, replies asked to stay within 110 characters and shown up to 220 (two pages of the strip); the proxy must hold the same numbers. Push-to-talk (agent.voice): a clip is at most 10 s, 24 clips per visit, 7 s to wait for its words; quieter than silence_peak is not sent.

arrivals.note: Added 2026-11-15: shift_order is who comes in; each shift draws the order from its seed. The first shift of a session opens with a steady patient. --authored-order keeps the listed order (tests and captures).

titles_note: The first entry that fits is used. min_correct counts right calls (out of five). max_injuries and rent_paid are optional: a night that hurt you, or that did not cover the rent, is not given a title that says it went well.

titles.title: STEADY HANDS
titles.text: Five patients, five right calls. The sheet goes back on its nail. You open again tomorrow.

titles.title: RIGHT THE HARD WAY
titles.text: Every call was right, and one of them still reached you. Reading people is half the job. The shutter is the other half.

titles.title: A GOOD NIGHT'S WORK
titles.text: One visit went wrong. Most nights are like that. The rest went the way they should.

titles.title: OPEN, BARELY
titles.text: You were right more often than not. In this trade that is not the same as safe.

titles.title: LICENCE UNDER REVIEW
titles.text: The sheet was on the clipboard the whole time. Read it again before the next shift.

rent_text.paid: Rent is paid. The lights stay on another night.
rent_text.short: Rent is short. The landlord will be back for the rest.
